strategies.name: DES master key recovery from 48-bit round-1 subkey via PC-2 inverse + parity enumeration
strategies.trigger_condition: Non-profiled CPA on DES (any device class: contact smartcard, contactless smartcard, FPGA, MCU). The DES CPA tool has returned a high-confidence round-1 48-bit subkey K1 (high_confidence_count >= 6/8 S-boxes, gap_pct >= 20%, avg_correlation reasonable for the device class), BUT encrypt_decrypt_verify against the DES master key has returned MISMATCH. The DES CPA tool may have populated a 'master_key' field with a placeholder (K1 zero-padded, K1 duplicated, or an arbitrary parity assignment) that is not the actual master key.
strategies.content: [{"principle": "DES has a 64-bit master key (with 8 parity bits) and CPA on round 1 only directly recovers the 48-bit round-1 subkey K1. Recovering the master key from K1 requires (a) inverting PC-2 to recover C1||D1 (56 bits with 8 missing positions), (b) right-shifting by 1 to recover C0||D0, (c) inverting PC-1 to recover the 64-bit master key with 8 unknown parity bits. The total brute-force space is 2^8 (PC-2 missing) x 2^8 (parity) = 65,536 candidates, well within key_search default budget.", "reason": "Five DES bits per S-box are NOT selected by PC-2; PC-2 selects 48 of 56 C||D bits. Therefore K1 alone does not uniquely determine the master key — an exhaustive 8-bit enumeration over the missing PC-2 positions is required. Additionally, the 8 master-key parity bits (every 8th bit) are not part of the key schedule and must also be enumerated (8 bits parity, but they can also be derived from the parity rule: each byte has odd parity, so once the other 7 bits are known the parity bit is determined — this collapses parity enumeration to 1 candidate per PC-2-missing assignment). In practice, agents observing high CPA confidence on K1 mistakenly treat the CPA tool's reported 'master_key' field as ground truth, but that field is often a zero-padded or arbitrary-parity guess that cannot pass encrypt_decrypt_verify.", "anti_patterns": ["Treat the DES CPA tool's reported `master_key` field as authoritative when encrypt_decrypt_verify returns MISMATCH; the field is a guess at parity assignment, not the verified master key", "Conclude 'CPA tool has a bug' when K1 is high-confidence but master-key verification fails — the bug is not in the CPA tool but in the parity / PC-2 missing-bit assumption", "Pivot to a different leakage target (S-box_in vs S-box_out) when K1 is already high-confidence; the K1 recovery is correct, only the K1 -> master-key reconstruction is failing", "Re-run preprocessing or alignment when K1 is high-confidence — alignment is fine, the issue is downstream", "Manually fabricate a master key by zero-padding K1, duplicating K1 to 64 bits, or guessing parity bits; this never passes verification and burns rounds"], "correct_behavior": ["Step 1: When DES CPA returns high-confidence K1 (hc >= 6/8, gap_pct >= 20%) but encrypt_decrypt_verify reports MISMATCH, do NOT pivot CPA parameters. The K1 itself is likely correct.", "Step 2: Invoke key_search with --algo des on the DES cpa_detail file. Default key_search budget (50000 candidates) already covers the 256x256=65536 PC-2-missing x parity combinations.", "Step 3: If key_search returns found=true with a different master_key than the CPA tool's reported field, USE THE key_search RESULT. The CPA tool's master_key field is a placeholder.", "Step 4: If key_search returns found=false at default budget, escalate budget to 500000 (see the key_search escalation ladder). DES master-key search is bounded; if 500000 still fails, the K1 itself has a wrong S-box subkey (Hamming distance >= 1 from true K1 prevents reconstruction).", "Step 5 (fallback if key_search lacks DES PC-2 inverse): use python_jupyter to manually implement PC-2 inverse. PC-2 maps 56-bit C||D to 48-bit K. The 8 missing positions are well-documented (DES standard FIPS 46-3). For each of 2^8=256 missing-bit assignments, derive C1||D1, right-shift to get C0||D0, apply PC-1^{-1} to get 64 bits with parity rule (each byte odd parity), test with encrypt_decrypt_verify. Total <= 256 verifications.", "Step 6: If after all of Step 1-5 verification still fails, CPA on round 1 was NOT high-confidence enough (some S-boxes likely have HD >= 1 from true K1). At that point pivot to round 2 CPA (using R_xor_LOut target on contactless smartcards / FPGAs) or recollect more traces.", "Step 7: For DES-14443 hardware HD specifically: K1 recovered via R_xor_LOut target should be treated identically — the master-key reconstruction protocol is the same regardless of leakage model."]}]
strategies.rationale: CPA on round 1 recovers only the 48-bit subkey K1. PC-2 omits eight bits of the 56-bit state and the parity bits are fixed by the byte parity rule, so the master key is one of at most 256 candidates; enumerating them is bounded and far cheaper than re-running the attack.
strategies.empirical_threshold: {"k1_high_confidence_threshold": "high_confidence_count >= 6 of 8 S-boxes AND gap_pct >= 20% AND avg_correlation appropriate for device class", "expected_master_key_search_space": "2^8 (PC-2 missing) x 1 (parity derivable from byte parity rule) = 256 candidates worst case", "key_search_default_budget_sufficient": "50000 default budget covers 256x worst case, no escalation usually needed", "diagnostic_signal_for_this_strategy": {"k1_hc_high": ">= 6/8", "verify_mismatch": "True", "cpa_tool_master_key_field_unreliable": "may contain K1+padding or arbitrary parity guess", "mandatory_response": "invoke key_search --algo des; do NOT pivot CPA parameters or alignment"}, "des_pc2_reference": "FIPS 46-3 Appendix; PC-2 selects 48 of 56 bits, missing positions: {9,18,22,25,35,38,43,54} in 1-indexed notation (8 missing positions = 2^8 search)"}

strategies.name: Do NOT declare key-recovery success based on CPA-internal metrics; encrypt_decrypt_verify MATCH is mandatory
strategies.trigger_condition: Any non-profiled CPA workflow on AES / DES / SM4 across any device class. Triggered whenever the agent has obtained a CPA output (typically high_confidence_count, gap_pct, avg_correlation looking favourable for the device class) and is about to write a final natural-language success message to the user, OR is considering terminating the session.
strategies.content: [{"principle": "A CPA output with high internal confidence (hc >= block-byte-count thresholds, gap_pct >= 20%, avg_correlation appropriate for the device class) is NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT for declaring key-recovery success. The only ground-truth success signal is encrypt_decrypt_verify returning verification=PASSED (MATCH on all ciphertext bytes). Until that tool call has been made and has returned MATCH, the candidate key is just a hypothesis — possibly correct, possibly off by one S-box subkey, possibly off in master-key reconstruction. Treating the CPA tool's reported candidate as the final answer skips the verification stage that exists precisely to catch these cases.", "reason": "DES, SM4, and AES key recovery have qualitatively different reconstruction paths between CPA output and master-key verification: DES requires PC-2 inverse + parity (covered by Strategy strat_des_master_key_recovery_protocol); SM4 requires four round-key recoveries followed by SM4 key-schedule reverse; AES only requires direct round-1 subkey verification but even there, dual-mode (HW vs k XOR 0xFF for HD targets) may need disambiguation. In each case the CPA tool's FIRST candidate is often wrong even when CPA-internal metrics are excellent, and only encrypt_decrypt_verify can disambiguate. Furthermore, in trace-budget-limited cases (100 traces, contact smartcards), one or two S-box subkeys may have hc that LOOKS high but is wrong by 1 — these cases require key_search to enumerate near-neighbours, which only kicks in after a verify MISMATCH is observed.", "anti_patterns": ["Write a final summary like 'I successfully recovered the master key 0x...' or '密钥 X 已成功恢复' or 'Key recovered: ...' before encrypt_decrypt_verify has returned MATCH", "Treat a CPA tool's reported `master_key` field as the final answer when encrypt_decrypt_verify has not been called", "Conclude success based on hc=full or gap_pct >= some threshold without an explicit verification tool call", "Bold/highlight a candidate key in the final output before it has been verified — the bold key may turn out to be the K1 padded, an arbitrary parity guess, or a near-neighbour of the true key", "Skip encrypt_decrypt_verify because 'CPA looks correct' — the verify call is cheap, mandatory, and the ONLY ground-truth signal", "After encrypt_decrypt_verify returns MISMATCH, immediately pivot to a DIFFERENT leakage target / leakage model / re-collect traces, instead of first trying the standard recovery paths (key_search for DES master-key reconstruction, dual-mode k vs k XOR 0xFF for AES HD, multi-CPA candidate merging for partial bytes)"], "correct_behavior": ["Step 1: After ANY CPA invocation that returns a candidate key, the IMMEDIATE next tool call MUST be encrypt_decrypt_verify on that candidate. Do not write any natural-language conclusion in between.", "Step 2: encrypt_decrypt_verify result must be the basis of the success/failure decision. verification=PASSED (MATCH) → success can be declared. verification=FAILED (MISMATCH) → continue diagnostic loop; do NOT terminate session.", "Step 3: On verify MISMATCH, the diagnostic ladder is: (a) for DES: invoke key_search per Strategy strat_des_master_key_recovery_protocol; (b) for AES with HD targets: try k XOR 0xFF dual-mode candidate; (c) for SM4: confirm all 4 round keys recovered, then verify each round-key independently before claiming master-key success; (d) for any cipher: invoke key_search with default 50000 budget if not yet tried; (e) only after these standard recovery paths fail should the agent pivot leakage target / preprocessing / re-collect traces.", "Step 4: A natural-language success message must contain explicit reference to the verify result, e.g. 'encrypt_decrypt_verify PASSED with MATCH on all 16 ciphertext bytes; recovered master key = ...', NOT just 'I recovered the master key = ...'", "Step 5: If the round budget is nearly exhausted and no MATCH has been obtained, the correct termination output is 'CPA produced candidate K = ... with hc = .../... and gap_pct = ...%, but encrypt_decrypt_verify returned MISMATCH after attempting key_search and standard recovery paths', NOT 'recovered master key = ...'."]}]
strategies.rationale: CPA-internal metrics are necessary but not sufficient: a candidate can be off by one S-box subkey or by the master-key reconstruction step while still showing a high hc. encrypt_decrypt_verify is the only ground-truth signal, so success is declared only after it returns MATCH.
strategies.empirical_threshold: {"ground_truth_success_signal": "encrypt_decrypt_verify return field verification == 'PASSED' AND 'MATCH' substring in details", "internal_confidence_signals_insufficient_alone": {"AES_hc": "16/16 high-confidence does NOT guarantee success (HD dual-mode can give k vs k XOR 0xFF tie)", "DES_hc": "8/8 high-confidence does NOT guarantee success (K1 is 48-bit; master-key reconstruction needed)", "SM4_hc_per_round": "4/4 per round does NOT guarantee success (need 4 rounds + key-schedule reverse)", "gap_pct": ">= 20% is necessary but DES/SM4 may still need post-CPA reconstruction"}, "mandatory_verify_call_count_per_session": "at least 1 (cannot terminate session as success without it)"}

indicates.cause_name: AC coupling removes DC offset, and a bandwidth limit filter reduces high-frequency noise, making it easier to see the signal of interest.
indicates.source_text: you'll want to set it up to use AC coupling and most likely a bandwidth limit filter. It's much easier to impose a bandwidth filter on the scope than to do so in code!

indicates.cause_name: Differential probes reject common-mode noise and avoid ground loop issues, providing a cleaner measurement of the voltage drop across the shunt resistor.
indicates.source_text: use a differential probe for your front end.

indicates.cause_name: Noise on the power supply rail can couple into the measurement and obscure the subtle current variations of the cryptographic operation.
indicates.source_text: Spend time getting the supply side as clean as possible using caps and even ferrite beads.

indicates.cause_name: Different key bytes (e.g., 0x55 and 0xAA) can have the same Hamming weight, making them indistinguishable if attacking the key directly. The S-box output provides a nonlinear transformation that spreads the Hamming weights, creating a unique signature for each key hypothesis.
indicates.source_text: Why don't we attack the read of the key straight from the register? ... imagine you have a 0x55 and a 0xAA in the round key. Both have the same number of 1's and zeros. We would have a hard time deciphering the true value without a conversion we gain from the Inverse Sbox step.

indicates.cause_name: Internal core voltage regulators have switching activity that masks the subtle current variations of the cryptographic operations.
indicates.source_text: overdrive the supply on the capacitor side of the resistor... we found around 1.52v to be sufficient.

indicates.cause_name: PGE indicates the rank of the correct key guess. A low PGE (approaching 1) for a key byte indicates high confidence, while a high PGE indicates low confidence or a wrong attack configuration.
indicates.source_text: The correlation, or Partial Guessing Entropy (PGE) indicator... is your gauge as to if your change helped or hurt your attack.

indicates.cause_name: unstable power supply introduces noise into power traces
indicates.source_text: 电源越稳定，测量配置的效果越好。关于电源稳定性的细节，可以在其生产厂家提供的资料中查到。

indicates.cause_name: unstable clock frequency or amplitude couples noise into power traces
indicates.source_text: 为了将时钟信号带来的噪声减少到最低，推荐使用正弦时钟信号代替三角波时钟信号。

indicates.cause_name: noise from connected components on the same PCB couples into the power measurement
indicates.source_text: 推荐在PCB板上使用尽可能少的部件。测量板与接口板通过通信线上的光电耦合器或磁耦合器进行电隔离。

indicates.cause_name: electromagnetic radiation from the device or cables interferes with the measurement
indicates.source_text: 测量配置中的辐射发射可以通过屏蔽来降低。一种很好地处理辐射发射的例子是把被攻击设备的PCB置于法拉第笼中。

indicates.cause_name: low resolution of the digital oscilloscope's ADC introduces quantization errors
indicates.source_text: 对于能量分析攻击而言，8位的分辨率通常是足够的。在这种情况下，量子化噪声就已经比其他的噪声小了很多。

indicates.cause_name: low bandwidth of the connection between the device and oscilloscope filters high-frequency components, causing energy from multiple switching activities to overlap in time
indicates.source_text: 我们的测量配置仅能测量一个时钟周期内的总能量消耗。所以，转换噪声与被攻击元件在同一个时钟周期发生转换活动的所有元件相对应。

indicates.cause_name: high clock frequency causes power consumption spikes from consecutive clock cycles to overlap, increasing effective switching noise
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimental observation with varying clock frequencies
indicates.source_text: 频率越高，所测量到能量迹中的转换噪声也就越大。这是由于相连的时钟周期内的能量消耗信号交叠程度的加剧造成的。

indicates.cause_name: high sampling rate captures many points per clock cycle, but most information is contained in peaks corresponding to total switching activity per cycle
indicates.diagnostic_check: correlation analysis between measured traces and simulated switching counts
indicates.source_text: 通过简单地提取出每一个时钟周期中的最大尖峰值，就可以对能量迹进行显著的压缩。

indicates.cause_name: statistical confidence requires a certain number of traces to distinguish the correct key hypothesis from zero correlation
indicates.diagnostic_check: statistical derivation using confidence intervals
indicates.source_text: 作为经验法则，实施一次成功DPA攻击所需要的能量迹的数量n可以计算如下: n = (3.719 / p)^2

indicates.cause_name: different instructions activate different hardware components with distinct power characteristics
indicates.diagnostic_check: visual inspection of traces from a known software implementation
indicates.source_text: 通过对能量迹中的模式进行识别，就可以确定出不同类型的数据传送指令。

indicates.cause_name: microcontroller uses a precharged bus, making power consumption inversely proportional to the Hamming weight of the data being processed
indicates.diagnostic_check: comparison of DPA results using different power models
indicates.source_text: 如果使用汉明重量模型，针对微控制器的DPA攻击则会需要较少的能量迹。这是因为较之比特模型，汉明重量模型能够更好地刻画微控制器的能量消耗。

indicates.cause_name: hardware implementations often have registers where power depends on the Hamming distance between successive values, or S-boxes consume less power for zero inputs
indicates.diagnostic_check: comparison of DPA results using different power models on an AES ASIC
indicates.source_text: 基于汉明距离模型的DPA攻击已经非常成功。这是由于S盒输入和密文均被储存在相同的寄存器，而汉明距离模型很好地刻画了储存密文时AES芯片的能量消耗。

indicates.cause_name: the chosen power model (e.g., bit or Hamming weight) does not accurately capture the data-dependent power consumption of the target circuit
indicates.diagnostic_check: simulation of power consumption using annotated netlist shows similar correlations for many key hypotheses
indicates.source_text: 观察到这个现象的攻击者可以从中得知该设备确实可以被攻击，但所使用的能量模型并不合适。在AES ASIC的情况中，比特模型和汉明重量模型不适用于攻击S盒的输入，而ZV模型可以得到不错的结果。

indicates.cause_name: Traces are misaligned due to random insertion of dummy operations or out-of-order execution, which linearly reduces the correlation.
indicates.source_text: 整合失调能量迹可以增强DPA攻击的效果.能量迹的失调导致相关系数线性降低，而对失调能量迹进行整合则会使得相关系数的降低以整合时钟周期数的平方根为系数。

indicates.cause_name: For devices leaking Hamming weight, the absolute difference preprocessing function maximizes the correlation between the combined hypothetical value and the preprocessed trace.
indicates.source_text: 就对泄漏汉明重量设备实施的二阶 DPA攻击而言，使用绝对差值进行预处理是一个不错的选择。

indicates.cause_name: DPA exploits statistical correlations between power consumption and intermediate data that depend on the secret key.
indicates.source_text: DPA attack does not need the knowledge of the implementation details and alternatively exploiting statistical methods... The data masking technique is the most widely used countermeasure against power analysis and timing attacks at a software level.

indicates.cause_name: SPA can deduce the secret key by observing the power consumption pattern of a single execution, which may reveal key-dependent operations.
indicates.source_text: In SPA attacks, the aim is essentially to guess from the power trace which particular instruction is being executed at a certain time... de-correlate the output traces on individual runs (e.g., by introducing random timing shifts and wait states, inserting dummy instructions...).

indicates.cause_name: Electromagnetic emanations can be measured and analyzed similarly to power consumption, providing a side channel that leaks information about computations.
indicates.source_text: Countermeasures against EM attacks on specific implementations fall into two broad categories: signal strength reduction and signal information reduction.

indicates.cause_name: The exact timing and length of the target cryptographic operation are unknown in the initial capture setup.
indicates.source_text: 不同设备的电气特征不同，软件中的参数配置文件的参数不一定能采到我们想要的波形，可以先采集一条整条波形，再调整参数采集多条我们想要的波形。

indicates.cause_name: High-frequency noise can obscure the lower-frequency signal components containing the power consumption leakage.
indicates.source_text: 该功能通过滑动平均的方式实现低通滤波，滤除高频噪声保留低频信号。

indicates.cause_name: To capture a specific round (e.g., first round) efficiently, the exact delay and sample count must be determined from the device's waveform.
indicates.source_text: 可以先采集一条整条波形，再调整参数采集多条我们想要的波形。

indicates.cause_name: DES key bytes include a parity bit (LSB) that is often ignored or set to zero by encryption software/hardware.
indicates.source_text: 由于DES算法密钥的每个字节最后一位是校验位，软件进行加密操作时校验位被置零，因此恢复出密钥的每个字节最后一比特位仍然是零。

indicates.cause_name: To ensure the alignment search range covers the actual maximum left/right shift observed in the traces
indicates.diagnostic_check: Visually inspect sample traces to measure maximum left and right shifts
indicates.source_text: 最大偏移量不能少于左右偏移量中较大的值

indicates.cause_name: The second trace is often of good quality and representative of the trace set
indicates.diagnostic_check: Check trace quality metrics for early traces in the acquisition
indicates.source_text: 通常情况下选择第二条波形为参考波形

indicates.cause_name: Random process interrupts and random clock delays cause non-linear misalignment that static (shift-only) alignment cannot correct
indicates.diagnostic_check: Inspect waveform segments after the aligned region for remaining misalignment
indicates.source_text: 弹性对齐更适用于难以通过静态对齐得到对齐效果的波形

indicates.cause_name: Calculating similarity at every sample point is computationally expensive
indicates.diagnostic_check: Measure alignment time for large trace sets
indicates.source_text: 在寻找最佳对齐位置时，为了提高对齐速度，在"参数设置"引入了变量"步长"。若"步长"过大，对齐的效果会受影响。

indicates.cause_name: The S-box output is a non-linear operation that often exhibits strong leakage in HW model, and is a common target in first-round attacks
indicates.diagnostic_check: Check implementation details for known leakage points
indicates.source_text: 攻击位置为第一轮字节代换的输出，"Target"选择"S-box out"，泄露模型为汉明重量模型，"Model"选择"HW"。

indicates.cause_name: GPU memory is insufficient for the trace length or processing chain
indicates.source_text: If the GPU memory is available, the analysis fails and Inspector falls back to using the CPU.

indicates.cause_name: Different methods offer trade-offs in resource usage, noise sensitivity, and result quality
indicates.source_text: Differential ... uses less resources than correlation, but is more sensitive to noise. Correlation ... usually gives the best trade-off between performance and result. Linear Regression ... typically yields the best results but requires a lot of resources.

indicates.cause_name: Peak only considers the highest point, while Sum accounts for multiple leakage points above noise threshold
indicates.source_text: Peak: Just search for the highest peak in the result trace. Sum: Add all values in the selection that exceed a noise threshold given by 2/√n, where n is the number of traces.

indicates.cause_name: traces are very noisy
indicates.source_text: Success is not always guaranteed if the traces are very noisy. In that case it is recommended spectral filtering.

indicates.cause_name: correlation calculation is computationally heavy
indicates.source_text: There is an option in the Settings window called 'Remove lag for reference correlation' which increases the speed but does not guarantee correctness.

indicates.cause_name: parameters (Min length, Step, Range) are not properly tuned
indicates.source_text: Dynamic alignment can be complicated and can only be achieved by a trial-and-error process in which you tune the parameters until the alignment is satisfactory.

indicates.cause_name: trace is poorly aligned
indicates.source_text: Minimum correlation allows filtering traces based on the amount of misalignment. If the correlation between the reference trace and the aligned trace is lower than the threshold value, the aligned trace is rejected.

indicates.cause_name: deviating clock speeds
indicates.source_text: Static or dynamic alignment is suboptimal when a trace set contains traces whose misalignment steadily grows due to deviating clock speeds.

indicates.cause_name: traces are misaligned or have too much noise
indicates.source_text: Before correlation can be established, the input traces should be aligned, and they may also require other filtering to reduce noise.

indicates.cause_name: key recovery algorithm is disabled
indicates.source_text: W (Key recovery limit): Indicates the maximum number of candidates to be considered in each step of the key recovery algorithm. When this value is set to 0 the key search algorithm will not be run.

indicates.cause_name: the 'First' field should not be changed because it is set automatically
indicates.source_text: Since the position of the first byte is known (and automatically set by the module in the 'First' field; be careful not to change it otherwise the module will not give correct results)

indicates.cause_name: Large misalignment or missing samples in some traces
indicates.diagnostic_check: By observing low correlation values output by ElasticAlign
indicates.source_text: Trace6 has a lower correlation than the others. We can exclude it by setting the Minimum correlation value of ElasticAlign to 0.91.

indicates.cause_name: Random program interrupts cause misalignment in the middle of the trace, even if the trace is aligned at the beginning and end
indicates.diagnostic_check: By visually inspecting the traces
indicates.source_text: Therefore, we choose to elastically align the traces using the Elastic Align module found in the Align category.

indicates.cause_name: S-box lookup order is randomized, causing misalignment in the S-box lookup area
indicates.diagnostic_check: By visually inspecting the traces
indicates.source_text: Set a maximum shift of 0 and a threshold value of 0.90. We should have about 100 traces remaining after this process.

indicates.cause_name: To correlate trace points with assembly instructions, the sampling rate must be high enough to capture each machine cycle. With a 12 MHz crystal (1 MHz machine cycle) and 250 MSa/s, each machine cycle corresponds to 250 sample points.
indicates.source_text: 标准的8051单片机执行一个单周期指令需要12个系统时钟周期，本系统采用12MHz时钟晶振...示波器采样率设置为250MSa/s...对于单机器周期的指令，每条指令对应250个点。

indicates.cause_name: Direct CPA computes correlation for every sample point across all key guesses, which is computationally heavy when traces have many points (e.g., 8000).
indicates.source_text: 我们将泄露区间设为从415到415...在选定的区间内求相关系数的均值，作为密钥区分器。

indicates.cause_name: If the same mask value is reused to mask two different intermediate values (e.g., y1 and y2), then the absolute difference of the two corresponding trace segments |T1 - T2| is correlated with |HW(y1 ⊕ y2)|, which is independent of the mask.
indicates.source_text: 如果两个中间值被相同的掩码异或，则可以对这两个位置对应的波形进行运算，以抵消掩码的作用。

indicates.cause_name: Electromagnetic probes capture radiated emissions, which are typically weaker and noisier than direct power consumption measurements.
indicates.source_text: 由于电磁信号较弱，我们将能量量程改为"20mV"。

indicates.cause_name: Without a dedicated trigger, the encryption operation is buried in a long trace. Low-frequency noise and irrelevant operations obscure the pattern.
indicates.source_text: 在低采样率下，采集较长的波形，确定AES加密的区间...可以切换到"波形处理"选项卡，点击"滤波"按钮。

indicates.cause_name: Low sampling rate is good for finding the interval but lacks the resolution needed to see individual instruction leaks for CPA.
indicates.source_text: 为使波形更精确地反映能量信息，我们将采样率提高为25M，设置采样条数为50，采样前触发点为-249000，采样点数为42000。

indicates.cause_name: Random delays inserted between operations cause the same operation to appear at different sample indices in different traces, making direct averaging impossible.
indicates.source_text: 滤波后的波形有十六个特征相同的区间，选中第一个区间...根据观察填写波形对齐参数，然后点击"对齐"按钮。

indicates.cause_name: Extending the time between two encryptions allows for better waveform separation and control over the acquisition rate.
indicates.source_text: 设置加密间隔可以延长两次加密之间的间隔时间

indicates.cause_name: Automated leakage analysis can identify the time interval where the cryptographic operation leaks information, providing a good starting point for CPA.
indicates.source_text: 首先进行泄露分析，点击按钮即可，会自动填入合适的泄露区间

indicates.cause_name: Efficiency analysis estimates the number of traces required to distinguish the correct key, providing a quantitative measure of the attack's success and data requirements.
indicates.source_text: 效率分析，点击效率分析可以得出区分出密钥需要的波形数，从而直观显示 CPA 效率

indicates.cause_name: Electromagnetic interference from poorly arranged cables/probes and nearby high-radiation devices (e.g., mobile phones).
indicates.diagnostic_check: Observed as significant vertical抖动 on the energy waveform (channel 2).
indicates.source_text: 通道 2 的能量波形上下抖动显著，建议合理布局开发板上连接的所有导线、探头线的位置，确保其相互干扰较小；同时应使开发板远离手机等高辐射电磁设备；此外，我们在分析程序的源码中附带了波形纵向标准化的功能，可有效抵消这种上下抖动。

indicates.cause_name: Multiplicative masking does not mask the all-zero byte value, leaving it unchanged. The zero input to the S-box remains zero after multiplication by any mask, creating a predictable intermediate variable that satisfies the DPA fundamental hypothesis.
indicates.source_text: the basic problem with the multiplicative mask is that it does not mask the all-zero byte value of data

indicates.cause_name: Using the same random mask for multiple S-box transformations within a single AES execution creates a correlation between intermediate variables. An attacker can perform a second-order DPA by analyzing power consumption at two points in time where the same mask is used.
indicates.source_text: if two intermediate variables both satisfy the fundamental hypothesis for DPA and are masked by the same mask, then their mutual correlation can be used to mount a second-order DPA attack

indicates.cause_name: CMOS FPGA power consumption is proportional to switching activity, making bit transition model effective
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental correlation between global prediction vector (bit transitions) and global consumption vector (measured power) was approximately 0.45
indicates.source_text: An estimation of the FPGA power consumption at time t is given by the number of bit transitions in the device registers at this time. This hypothesis was successfully used in, e.g. [30], [31], [37], [38].

indicates.cause_name: Pearson correlation is simple, well-understood, and effective without noise estimation
indicates.source_text: An efficient way to perform the correlation between theoretical predictions and real measurements is to use the Pearson coefficient.

indicates.cause_name: Global prediction vector provides theoretical noise-free baseline for feasibility estimation
indicates.diagnostic_check: Simulated attacks showed successful key distinction after ~300-600 traces
indicates.source_text: theoretical predictions of the attack can be performed by using the global prediction matrix instead of the global consumption matrix... may help to determine the minimum number of texts needed

indicates.cause_name: Correlation between theoretical and measured vectors quantifies model accuracy and measurement quality
indicates.diagnostic_check: Computed correlation for N=1 to 2000, yielding approximately 0.45
indicates.source_text: we computed the correlation coefficient between the global prediction vector and the global consumption vector... confirming our hypothesis to provide a reasonable estimation

indicates.cause_name: Statistical analysis shows required traces inversely proportional to square of correlation coefficient
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical predictions matched experimental results (e.g., r_{P,M}=0.09 required ~1200 traces with c≈10 for g=256, SR=0.9)
indicates.source_text: the number of plaintexts N_0.9 required to mount a correlation analysis attack can simply be estimated with: N_0.9 ≈ c / (r_{P,M})^2

indicates.cause_name: Individual countermeasures only reduce leakage and can be bypassed by improved attacks
indicates.diagnostic_check: References to higher-order attacks, template attacks, and re-synchronization techniques
indicates.source_text: the combination of different techniques (including noise addition, randomization, duplication, masking, ...) allows reaching a certain level of actual security.

indicates.cause_name: Correlation increases when more bits are used in the prediction, with full byte (8 bits) giving the highest correlation
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical calculation shown in Table 1.
indicates.source_text: attacking a full byte is the best choice

indicates.cause_name: Correlation increases slightly for β=2 or 3 but decreases for higher values of β
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical calculation shown in Table 1.
indicates.source_text: The correlation increases slightly for β = {2,3} but decreases for higher values of β.

indicates.diagnostic_check: Formula from statistics.
indicates.source_text: the number of traces can be calculated as follows N = (Z_{1-α/2} / ρ)^2

indicates.cause_name: The targeted intermediate values are processed in a distinct part of the power trace, e.g., a sequence of similar operations

indicates.cause_name: On real (noisy) curves, a clear collision is indicated by a high correlation peak over a specific interval, not just a single point.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Empirical testing on the chip

indicates.cause_name: Collision-correlation is more efficient than classical model-based CPA and can detect collisions with very few traces per fixed message.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Successful attack on real curves
indicates.source_text: The attack was successful using N = 25 so that less than 1 500 traces allow to recover the key.

indicates.cause_name: using signal variance (SV) for dimension reduction, which is suboptimal for collision detection
indicates.diagnostic_check: empirical evaluation using α-divergence metric
indicates.source_text: Dimension reduction by variance, SV, which works well in DPA attacks, only moderately improves collision detection. Whereas both new methods, SD and WSD, lead to clearly more efficient collision detection, WSD being superior.

indicates.cause_name: using standalone collision attack or standalone DPA attack, which do not exploit all available key information
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimental comparison of success rates
indicates.source_text: One can see that the combination of collision attacks with DPA clearly outperforms both collision-only and DPA-only attacks.

indicates.cause_name: testing all chain guesses (2^{8h}) without prior information
indicates.diagnostic_check: theoretical analysis
indicates.source_text: In the combined approach, we effectively test m candidates for each chain. Moreover, we filter our improbable chain candidates separately for each chain. This results in a lower number of full 16-byte key candidates to be tested.

indicates.cause_name: Bijective leakage function leads to constant mutual information when targeting a bijective intermediate function (e.g., AES Sbox).
indicates.source_text: A simple workaround for this problem is to choose ˆL as a bijective map of a subspace of W, e.g. one could choose ˆLˆk := the seven least significant bits of Wˆk.

indicates.cause_name: To avoid losing information and estimate probability distributions as accurately as possible.
indicates.source_text: use as many bins as there are distinct values in the domain covered by the sample set.

indicates.cause_name: The nature of observations (deterministic vs. probabilistic/noisy) affects how histograms should be generated.
indicates.source_text: Generating histograms is different depending on whether the observations of the random variable are deterministic or probabilistic (noisy).

indicates.cause_name: Fewer bins imply less information but may have the effect of noise reduction in noisy observations.
indicates.source_text: We usually work with bins of equal width. In general, less bins imply less information and vice versa.

indicates.cause_name: DPA-resistant logic (e.g., dual-rail precharge) breaks Hamming weight/distance model, rendering correlation attacks ineffective.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison showing correlation attack fails while MIA succeeds.
indicates.source_text: Since our distinguisher does not rely on a restrictive assumption about the leakage function, it is the method of choice for an attack against DRP logic.

indicates.cause_name: Leakage signals have non-zero offsets, which increases the variance of the product and reduces correlation.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis in Hamming weight model with noise
indicates.source_text: minimizing the variance of L(t1)×L(t2) can be done by centering the leakage signals L(t1) and L(t2) in zero (namely by substituting L(t)-E[L(t)] for L(t)).

indicates.cause_name: Offsets of the two leakages are not equal, which reduces the effect of the absolute value operation.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis showing that a large constant difference dominates the combined signal
indicates.source_text: it is important that δ1 be equal to δ2. Indeed, if there is a great difference between these values, then the effect of the absolute value is reduced.

indicates.cause_name: The optimal prediction function depends on the combining function and the leakage model.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Derivation of optimal prediction function fopt(z) = E[C | Z=z] for given combining function C
indicates.source_text: the optimal prediction function fopt corresponding to Cprod is of the form: fopt(z) = A(H(z)) where A is an affine decreasing function.

indicates.cause_name: Raising the combined leakage to a power α ≠ 1 decreases the correlation coefficient.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical computation of optimal correlation for C^α shows maximum at α=1 for both product and absolute difference combining
indicates.source_text: for every n, the maximum of the optimal correlations is reached for α=1. Thus, raising the combined leakage to a power is not a sound approach.

indicates.cause_name: Sine-based combining function requires exact Hamming weights and is not robust to even small noise.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Simulation showing correlation drops quickly with increasing noise deviation σ
indicates.source_text: the correlation for Csin quickly decreases as σ increases. For a noise deviation σ greater or equal to 0.4 the product combining offers a greater correlation.

indicates.cause_name: standard deviation σ of each component is much less than the distance between component means (N), i.e., σ ≪ N
indicates.diagnostic_check: statistical analysis and simulation of the mixture distribution
indicates.source_text: the distribution becomes multimodal whenever σ ≪ N. ... condition (1) b ≫ √N

indicates.cause_name: coefficient of variation can be misleading because attack trace count is inversely proportional to square of maximum probability mass function (p̂), not just standard deviation
indicates.source_text: the coefficient of variation was suggested as a criterion ... we argue that this measure is misleading and suggest a new criterion.

indicates.cause_name: original Floating Mean method requires long delays to avoid cogs, which contradicts security recommendation of using many short delays
indicates.diagnostic_check: analysis of parameter condition and security trade-off
indicates.source_text: condition (1) contradicts the requirement of having many short random delays. ... we propose an improved method.

indicates.cause_name: Masking countermeasure randomizes intermediate values but leaves a first-order leakage that can be exploited by comparing mean traces
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental results
indicates.source_text: The proposed attack breaks an AES implementation based on the corrected version of the masked S-box of Canright and Batina ... It requires only six times the number of traces necessary for breaking a comparable unprotected implementation.

indicates.cause_name: Masked implementations may still have first-order leakage that can be exploited by correlating mean traces of S-box computations.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison of attack efficiencies
indicates.source_text: The number of traces needed to overcome an implementation of the masking countermeasure only increases by a small factor of six when compared to a DPA on an unprotected implementation.

indicates.cause_name: In parallel architectures (e.g., 32-bit with four S-boxes), different S-box instances may have different placement and routing, leading to different power consumption characteristics.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison between 8-bit and 32-bit architectures
indicates.source_text: the best way would be to compare the power consumption of the same instance of the S-box in different clock cycles.

indicates.cause_name: Smaller S-boxes yield fewer points for correlation, making the estimation less reliable.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis of attack applicability
indicates.source_text: To solve this problem one can define a window and perform the attack not only on a single point in time, but also using other adjacent power points.

indicates.cause_name: The correlation-enhanced collision attack does not require a precise power model, netlist, or training with a known key.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Attack design and experimental success
indicates.source_text: the attack makes almost no assumptions about the leakage and does not require any detailed knowledge about the implementation.

indicates.cause_name: The correlation-enhanced collision attack works on both masked and unprotected implementations.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Practical evaluation on unprotected implementation
indicates.source_text: We have practically evaluated this issue as well; as a result around 3 000 traces are required for the attack on an unprotected implementation.

indicates.cause_name: Complexity of SCA on d-th order masked implementation grows exponentially with d
indicates.source_text: the complexity of performing an SCA grows exponentially with the order d

indicates.cause_name: ISW-based masking scheme is proven to be d-th order secure
indicates.source_text: the scheme achieves d th-order security rather than ( d/ 2)th-order security

indicates.cause_name: Bypass/voltage stabilization capacitors on the PCB smooth the power consumption; the ASIC connected to the same supply introduces wide-band noise
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison with EM probe measurement
indicates.source_text: Initial experiments to measure the power consumption by inserting a shunt resistor into the battery connection yielded heavily smoothed power traces, presumably due to several bypass/voltage stabilization capacitors on the PCB.

indicates.cause_name: The PIC runs on an internal RC oscillator at ~8 MHz. Filtering around this frequency band isolates the clock-related activity from out-of-band noise
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimentally varying the passband frequencies
indicates.source_text: Experimentally varying the lower and upper frequency of the passband, we found that a passband from 6 MHz to 9 MHz yields the best result.

indicates.cause_name: A precise trigger signal generated by the device under test provides a reliable reference point for aligning traces to the start of the target operation
indicates.diagnostic_check: Inserted a debug function to generate a trigger, then used the observed pattern to align traces from the unmodified device
indicates.source_text: We initially inserted a small function into the (otherwise unmodified) code of the PIC... This pattern can serve for alignment purposes.

indicates.cause_name: Analysis of the assembly code implementing the target function and the known leakage characteristics of the PIC microcontroller family indicate that the Hamming distance between the old and new value of a byte is a suitable model
indicates.diagnostic_check: Based on prior work (Goldack, 2008) and code analysis
indicates.source_text: We use the HD between a byte x_i^{(r)} and its updated value x_i^{(r+1)} as the power model... This model was derived based on the analysis of the assembly code implementing O and the leakage model for the PIC series.

indicates.cause_name: Histogram density estimation may not approximate continuous leakage distributions well under noisy conditions, while kernel density estimation provides smoother and more accurate estimates.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison on DPA Contest traces using Hamming distance model
indicates.source_text: the kernel-based MIA seems to perform better than its counterpart using histograms

indicates.cause_name: Correlation attacks exploit linear dependencies efficiently, while MIA is a more generic but less efficient distinguisher when the leakage model is accurate and linear.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison showing correlation attacks require fewer traces to achieve the same success rate.
indicates.source_text: classical attacks using the correlation coefficient are the most efficient in this simple context, where the models closely fit to the physics

indicates.cause_name: The shape of the leakage distribution changes with noise level and leakage model; histograms approximate Dirac-comb-like distributions well in low noise, while kernels handle continuous mixtures better under noise.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experiments on a masked DES implementation with controlled noise levels.
indicates.source_text: histograms perform well in the low noise scenario with a Hamming weight leakage model... kernel-MIA gains interest compared to histogram-MIA, when the amount of noise in the physical leakages increases

indicates.cause_name: Normalized product combining effectively captures the linear dependencies present in the leakages, making correlation attacks more efficient when the leakage model is linear.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison on a masked DES implementation.
indicates.source_text: the second-order DPA using the correlation coefficient and a normalized product combining function is the most efficient

indicates.cause_name: Inappropriate bin width leads to poor density estimation: too few bins lose information, too many bins require more samples for reliable estimation.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical and empirical studies in density estimation.
indicates.source_text: different bin sizes can have great impact on the estimation... reasonable choices are Scott's rule and Freedman-Diaconis rule

indicates.cause_name: For bijective S-boxes, different subkey candidates merely lead to different permutations of the same partition, leaving the conditional entropy (and mutual information) unchanged.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis and known limitation of partition-based attacks.
indicates.source_text: attacking bijective S-boxes such as the AES Rijndael ones, with the identity leakage model X = V, will not lead to successful attacks

indicates.cause_name: Polynomial degree grows exponentially with rounds; 3rd round offers optimal balance between recovered key bits and complexity
indicates.diagnostic_check: analysis of polynomial degree and number for each round
indicates.source_text: considering the recovered key bits number and polynomial complexity, the 3rd round would be the best choice for the attacker.

indicates.cause_name: Different bit positions have different polynomial degrees and numbers; lower degree/numbers reduce sample size and complexity
indicates.diagnostic_check: analysis of polynomial degree and number for 64 bit positions of the 3rd round S-box lookup
indicates.source_text: attacking the 1st bit of the S-box 0,1,2,3 would have quite low complexity.

indicates.cause_name: Integrated DPA is suboptimal because it does not exploit the structure of the shuffling countermeasure (e.g., permutation leakage).
indicates.diagnostic_check: Simulated experiments showing lower mutual information and success rate compared to Bayesian attacks.
indicates.source_text: we observe that the integrated attack is less efficient than the template attack with uniform prior.

indicates.cause_name: RSI shuffling only has 16 possible permutations, making enumeration computationally feasible.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Simulated experiments showing that rsienum-ta (enumeration of RSI permutations) achieves high success rate.
indicates.source_text: the RSI-based shuffled implementation remains as easy to attack as an unprotected one

indicates.cause_name: Indirect leakages exist due to different power consumption models of hardware resources (registers, memory accesses).
indicates.diagnostic_check: Practical experiments showing that templates built for different key bytes and cycles yield different distributions.
indicates.source_text: the fact that different key bytes give rise to different templates leads to indirect leakages on the permutation

indicates.cause_name: Different S-boxes have different leakage functions due to code optimizations (different registers used).
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental results showing one S-box leaking differently.
indicates.source_text: This can be explained by one of the S-boxes leaking in a drastically different way than the others in our implementation.

indicates.cause_name: Parameter estimation in Bayesian extension requires precision, which is not achieved with few traces due to different leakage models.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental results showing Bayesian extension only helpful after sufficient traces.
indicates.source_text: the Bayesian extensions were less directly useful. ... they were only useful after approximately 150 traces in this more challenging scenario.

indicates.cause_name: Leakage function is highly non-linear.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Simulated experiments with non-linear leakage function.
indicates.source_text: the stochastic approach is unable to exploit the non-linear leakages, and only collision attacks lead to successful key recoveries.

indicates.cause_name: Collision attacks can be re-written as an LDPC decoding problem, and soft-decoding improves efficiency by exploiting soft information.
indicates.source_text: finding the key in a linear collision attack consists in finding the likeliest codeword of the aforementioned LDPC code

indicates.cause_name: Normalized scores are not actual probabilities; Bayesian extension provides probabilities that improve LDPC decoder performance.
indicates.source_text: the Bayesian extension of the statistics used for collision detection, where the scores would be replaced by actual probabilities, could be a valuable addition

indicates.cause_name: Pre-processing with on-the-fly templates extracts first-order side-channel information (difference in mean values).
indicates.source_text: building 'on-the-fly' templates ... is typically useful to extract first-order side-channel information

indicates.cause_name: Distinguisher values (R^2) at different time indices are not directly comparable because linear regression adapts to instantaneous leakage, causing different score distributions across key hypotheses at each time
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental results on Device B (130nm) showed the correct key was not ranked first at the time index yielding the overall maximum R^2 value
indicates.source_text: the correct key candidate does not maximize the distinguisher value globally but only in a local area... we propose to replace the candidate selection step of the LRA by... normalizing the maximum of the coefficients of determination

indicates.cause_name: Classical LRA processes each trace individually, leading to matrix operations scaling with N
indicates.source_text: the processing of the vectors β is unchanged if performed for the set of averaged leakages... This improvement essentially lets the first 9 steps of Alg. 3 unchanged except the loop 7-8 which is now computed over x ∈ F_n^2

indicates.cause_name: Classical CPA computes correlation for each trace and each time index, leading to operations scaling with N
indicates.source_text: we propose to insert the following pre-processing in order (1) to partition the leakage traces according to the corresponding input values x_i and (2) to compute the mean for each partition.

indicates.cause_name: Classical TA computes a quadratic form for each trace, leading to O(N * d^2) operations
indicates.source_text: if the 2^n possible sums ∑_{i,x_i=x} L_i and ∑_{i,x_i=x} ℓ_i have been precomputed, then the complexity of evaluating (3) for each k̂ goes from O(N d^2) to O(2^n d^2).

indicates.cause_name: Working on raw traces with random delays is computationally expensive and difficult for attack. Splitting traces into clock cycles reduces complexity and facilitates subsequent alignment/analysis.
indicates.source_text: we first split the traces into consecutive clock cycles, using the Fast Fourier Transform to recover the rising edges of the clock signal.

indicates.cause_name: Traces contain many points but only a few are relevant for leakage; NICV can detect leakage points using public information without requiring a leakage model or clone device
indicates.source_text: NICV operates without the need of a clone device, i.e., it requires no profiling stage and use the same set of traces which are to be analyzed

indicates.cause_name: Ghost peaks are due to leakage at other points that are not the target, which can mislead the attack
indicates.source_text: If we compute the success rate on a window around samples where NICV is maximal, we are able to suppress the ghost peak.

indicates.cause_name: The number of shares n is too large compared to noise variance σ², violating n > c·σ²
indicates.diagnostic_check: entropy analysis
indicates.source_text: the noise standard deviation σ and the sharing order n must satisfy the following inequality for a side channel attack to be feasible: n > c · σ²

indicates.cause_name: The finite field representation may lead to identical Hamming weight distributions for different field elements
indicates.diagnostic_check: analysis of Hamming weight distributions
indicates.source_text: depending on the finite-field representation, we are not always guaranteed to recover the secret variable x*

indicates.cause_name: Using multiple points of interest increases the effective SNR and provides more information
indicates.diagnostic_check: practical experiments showing better results than univariate theory
indicates.source_text: we estimated the signal-to-noise ratio of the acquisitions at each point in order to identify the best points of interest

indicates.cause_name: The attack may not rank the correct hypothesis first for all shares, but shares often have good ranking
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimental results showing high ranking of correct hypotheses
indicates.source_text: combining this attack with one of the Key Enumeration (KEA) techniques recently developed should significantly increase the attack efficiency

indicates.cause_name: The same share is multiplied multiple times, allowing horizontal attacks to accumulate information
indicates.diagnostic_check: theoretical analysis and attack demonstrations
indicates.source_text: we describe a variant of Rivain-Prouff's multiplication that is still provably secure in the original ISW model, and also heuristically secure against our new attacks

indicates.cause_name: The confusion coefficient (κ) measures the relationship between different key hypotheses; its minimum value and variance indicate how easily the correct key can be distinguished. A higher minimum κ and lower variance suggest weaker inherent side-channel resistance.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis and empirical CPA simulations on multiple ciphers
indicates.source_text: the confusion coefficient measures the relationship between different key hypotheses... higher minimum, the lower the side-channel security

indicates.cause_name: The variance of the Hamming weight leakage for a 4-bit S-box is 1, while for an 8-bit S-box it is 2. This leads to a factor of 2 difference in SNR for the same additive noise. Additionally, the 4-bit S-box has only 16 classes vs 256, leading to more observations per class for a fixed trace count.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis of binomial distribution and empirical CPA simulations
indicates.source_text: V ar (HW( Sbox [ T ⊕ k ])) ... equal to 1 for 4-bit S-boxes and equal to 2 for 8-bit S-boxes

indicates.cause_name: To locate the EM leakage from the GPU, one must probe at positions where the encryption activity is likely to emit.
indicates.source_text: Generally speaking, only the right above of GPU chip and capacitors on the back of GPU chip should be checked, because these positions or components tend to produce useful leakages

indicates.cause_name: A reliable trigger is needed to capture the target signal without external triggers.
indicates.source_text: the more significant difference between Trigger and other signals in the upper channel makes Trigger A a better choice to work as a trigger

indicates.cause_name: Traces may be misaligned or of low quality, which would hinder subsequent analysis.
indicates.source_text: We exclude traces whose maximum PCC is less than 0.70. Then all traces with the maximum PCC no less than 0.70 could be aligned properly.

indicates.cause_name: Unbalanced plaintext distribution leads to biased leakage estimates, which can affect collision detection.
indicates.source_text: This balanced setup allows to remove the bias of the plaintext distribution and it can be easily implemented using shuffling of batches.

indicates.cause_name: For Gaussian distributed leakage function values, the scalar product distinguisher (D_sto.coll.bal) is optimal in the maximum likelihood sense.
indicates.source_text: Remarkably, this special result is independent of the parameters... It also shows the optimality in terms of maximum likelihood of the D_sto.coll.bal distinguisher in case of Gaussian distributed leakage function values.

indicates.cause_name: Existing extractors (TAILS) only maximize variance of data-dependent component and ignore noise component, resulting in limited SNR improvement
indicates.diagnostic_check: Compare SNR improvement between TAILS and noise-minimizing extractors
indicates.source_text: Existing extractors only maximize the variance of data-dependent power consumption component and ignore the noise component, which results in very limited SNR to improve.

indicates.cause_name: Directly using single noisy samples to estimate data-dependent component introduces significant estimation error
indicates.diagnostic_check: Analyze estimation error when using single samples vs. mean per plaintext byte
indicates.source_text: It is not very good to directly exploit l_i(τ) containing noise to estimate data-dependent power consumption, which will introduce significant but unnecessary estimation error.

indicates.cause_name: When attacker has enough traces to guarantee successful attacks, goal shifts from increasing success rate to lowering computational complexity
indicates.diagnostic_check: Check if trace count is sufficient for successful attacks
indicates.source_text: We only consider the case that the number of power traces owned by the attacker is sufficient to guarantee his successful attacks, and the goal of his extraction is to lower the complexity rather than increase the success rate.

indicates.cause_name: Using an injective leakage function loses no information about the intermediate value, making all keys equally likely under the mutual information metric.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theorem 1 proof
indicates.source_text: Theorem 1 states that DDLA with an injective leakage function cannot distinguish the correct key and any wrong key at all.

indicates.cause_name: No method exists to simultaneously estimate the correct key and the optimal leakage function without prior knowledge.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theorem 2 proof
indicates.source_text: DDLA essentially requires some knowledge or assumption on leakage characteristics to determine an appropriate g.

indicates.cause_name: The sum-of-probabilities distinguisher used in the original collision DL-SCA is not optimal.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical proof (Theorem 4) and simulation results
indicates.source_text: our distinguisher achieved the SR for a given number of traces, which was almost the same as that of the TA, ... our distinguisher and TA achieve higher performance than the Staib-Moradi collision DL-SCA.

indicates.cause_name: Training separate neural network per byte limits the amount of training data available for each model.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Architecture design rationale
indicates.source_text: the proposed NN architecture shares the same feature extractor for inference of the plaintext/ciphertext information of all bytes. This allows feature extractor training to be performed using 16 times more traces.

indicates.cause_name: The appropriate leakage function is device-dependent and cannot be determined without knowing the correct key.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental evaluation showing DDLA succeeded with MSB but failed with LSB
indicates.source_text: the performance of the DDLAs heavily depends on the leakage function ( i.e. , LSB or MSB herein). ... This indicates the instability of DDLA as a non-profiled SCA.

indicates.cause_name: Selection function is not bijective (or does not satisfy KIC) or side-channel leakages are not i.i.d. and separable in time domain.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Formal analysis of applicability conditions
indicates.source_text: The applicability of the collision DL-SCA depends on the following two conditions: ...

indicates.cause_name: Non-linear operations (e.g., S-box) have stronger power consumption leakage than linear transformations
indicates.diagnostic_check: Compare correlation strength between S-box output and linear operation points
indicates.source_text: the S-box is a non-linear transformation that generates significant power consumption during the transformation, as compared to linear transformations. Therefore, choosing this point as an intermediate value for power analysis attacks makes it easier to break the key.

indicates.cause_name: High-dimensional raw trace data leads to excessive computational complexity and training time
indicates.diagnostic_check: Measure training time with raw traces vs. reduced dimensionality

Regardless of the training mode, a dataset with 24,400 dimensions would require an impractically long training time. ... PCA reduces a set of potentially correlated high-dimensional variables into a set of lower-dimensional, linearly uncorrelated variables known as principal components.

indicates.cause_name: Excessive noise and irrelevant samples in the full trace dilute the relevant leakage signal, and temporal characteristics are important for model learning
indicates.diagnostic_check: Compare classification accuracy with full trace vs. selected window

indicates.cause_name: Leakage corresponds to instructions processing intermediate values (e.g., S-box output) that are impacted by a changed plaintext byte.

indicates.source_text: The cause of these leakages can be understood by observing the contents of a2 and a4 registers at these instructions... a2 stores a value that is impacted by a change in PT5, thus explaining the TVLA leaks.

indicates.cause_name: Register reuse in ShiftRows operation leads to mask cancellation: loading a new masked byte into a register that still holds a previous masked byte (with the same mask) effectively removes the mask, leaking Hamming distance.

indicates.cause_name: Fixed-vs-random TVLA only indicates leakage presence; fixed-vs-fixed TVLA (varying one or a few plaintext bytes) isolates leakage to specific intermediate values.

indicates.cause_name: Stochastic factors in training (for DL) or trace selection during evaluation (for non-profiled SCA) introduce significant variance; reporting only a single run does not reflect typical performance.

indicates.source_text: Statistics: Avoid 'best run only'; report variability (e.g., over seeds/splits and/or evaluation sampling) and specify what error bars summarize.

indicates.cause_name: Lack of accessible code, data, or precise preprocessing documentation prevents independent verification and comparison.

indicates.cause_name: Preprocessing steps (alignment, filtering, windowing, normalization) are often not fully documented, making it impossible to recreate the exact input traces.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Case study showing discrepancies when trying to reproduce results without exact preprocessing pipeline.

indicates.diagnostic_check: theoretical proof and empirical validation with simulated and real measurements

indicates.source_text: the selection of a leakage model has more impact on the success rate than the selection of the statistical tool to exploit this model.

indicates.cause_name: Carrier wave dominates ADC, saturating it and reducing effective bits for side-channel information
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical analysis and measurement
indicates.source_text: developed analog circuit ... capable of delaying and scaling the sine wave of the crystal, in order to match its amplitude and phase to that of the EM measurements, before subtracting the pure sine from the EM measurements.

indicates.cause_name: Asynchronous device operation causes timing variations outside region of interest
indicates.diagnostic_check: Observation that alignment with a single reference pattern failed for parts of the trace
indicates.source_text: the analyzed smartcard performs the operations in an asynchronous manner ... The alignment has thus to be performed with respect to the part of the trace we aim to examine

indicates.cause_name: Timing jitter from asynchronous operation and dummy cycles misaligns leakage points
indicates.diagnostic_check: Observation that correlation peaks were not sharp when using standard CPA
indicates.source_text: extract local maxima and minima ... grouped on the basis of their time coordinate by dividing the time axis into equal intervals or bins ... The CPA is performed binwise

indicates.cause_name: Optimal filter cutoffs are device-dependent and require experimental determination
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental determination
indicates.source_text: Good values for the filter cutoff frequencies f_lowpass and f_highpass were determined experimentally

indicates.cause_name: Data-dependent leakage occurs at clock edges, but jitter misaligns traces.
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimental observation
indicates.source_text: Another problem is that all of the target devices are clocked by a noisy internal oscillator. Hence we had to find a way to remove the clock jitter. ... we extract the peaks from the power consumption in software, and base our DPA attack solely on the amplitudes of the peaks.

indicates.cause_name: To avoid ghost peaks and have a strong DPA, choose an intermediate value with high nonlinearity with respect to the key.
indicates.source_text: Furthermore, it is advisable to choose a value that has a high degree of nonlinearity with respect to the key, to avoid so-called 'ghost peaks' for 'similar' keys.

indicates.cause_name: The combinational part leakage is small, key register has constant power (due to rotation), so focus on state register.
indicates.source_text: Hence, we focus on the state register y. We execute a correlation DPA attack (CPA) [2] based on the following hypothetical power model ...

indicates.cause_name: DIP packages have higher SNR than SOIC, and lower sampling rates require more traces.
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimental results
indicates.source_text: In the best case we were able to recover the secret key of DIP package ICs from only six power traces when sampling at a rate of 200 MS/s. At most 30 power traces are sufficient ... even with low-cost equipment, e.g., an oscilloscope with a maximum sample rate as low as 50MS/s enables finding the secret key from only 60 power traces.

indicates.cause_name: EM near field probe can capture the same leakage as power consumption, with similar SNR.
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimental comparison
indicates.source_text: Contrary to our assumption that the SNR would suffer from environmental noise ... the results obtained and the number of traces needed are very comparable to the case of power traces

indicates.cause_name: Data-dependent execution time leads to increasing misalignment over rounds.
indicates.diagnostic_check: observed during attack
indicates.source_text: While performing the attack we noticed that the correlation coefficient of the correct key become continuously worse with an increasing number of rounds. ... This gradual decrease of the correlation is due to a misalignment that occurs during the execution of the KeeLoq algorithm.

indicates.cause_name: In real-world targets, an IO line indicating encryption/decryption activity is often not exposed, making synchronization difficult.
indicates.source_text: Typical work demonstrating side-channel attacks uses an IO line of the microcontroller that indicates when the encryption (or decryption) routine is running. This provides an attacker with a perfectly synchronized trigger event, but in real implementations this will not be available. For this work the Sum of Absolute Differences (SAD) trigger built into the ChipWhisperer is used.

indicates.cause_name: The AES-256 implementation has non-constant execution time, causing later rounds to drift.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Visual inspection of power traces shows misalignment after sample 7300 in the first round.
indicates.source_text: Traces may also need to be synchronized in time. In particular the AES-256 implementation used here has nonconstant execution time... To compensate for this a SAD resynchronization element is used during analysis for the 13th round.

indicates.cause_name: The MixColumns inverse operation in round 13 mixes bytes, making a single-byte guess impossible if attacking the state directly.
indicates.source_text: We can however take advantage of the linearity of the Mix^{-1}(a) operation to rearrange (2)... Once we fully determine Y13, we can use (8) to determine the desired encryption key for round 13, K13.

indicates.cause_name: The IV is applied via a linear XOR operation. A single-bit change in the IV guess causes a single-bit change in the hypothetical leakage (Hamming Weight), leading to high correlation for guesses with similar bit patterns. Additionally, the bitwise inverse of the correct guess produces the same absolute correlation (opposite sign), confusing ranking.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Analysis of correlation table shows wrong guesses (e.g., 0x4A, 0x5A) have higher correlation than correct guess (0xDA) for byte 7; bitwise inverses (0x25, 0xA5, 0xB5) have high negative correlation.
indicates.source_text: The CPA attack never fully recovers the IV even with 5000 traces... Note the wrong guesses have a very close bit pattern to the correct value... the absolute value of the correlation cannot be used.

indicates.cause_name: The signature is a fixed 4-byte sequence prepended to each plaintext block before encryption. Once the key is recovered, the signature becomes visible in the decrypted data.
indicates.source_text: Provided the attacker has access to an encrypted firmware file, they can simply decrypt this file using the key determined with a CPA attack. The signature will be readily apparent due to the presence of a repeated fixed four-byte sequence in the decrypted file.

indicates.cause_name: Using random plaintext for all bytes does not isolate the target tweak byte, leading to lower correlation peaks and requiring more traces
indicates.source_text: 其中，xx代表为随机数，00代表该字节输入始终保持为固定值00。

indicates.cause_name: Due to the shifting operation, different hypotheses (e.g., values that are multiples of powers of two) can produce identical Hamming distance values at a single attack point, leading to false positives
indicates.source_text: 当只对一个目标点进行分析时，有多个相关假设值具有相同的汉明值特征...多阶段结合的 CPA 分析方法可以消除数据移位的影响。

indicates.cause_name: The linear transformation L after the S-boxes mixes the bytes, making the leakage of individual bytes difficult to isolate.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Analysis of the algorithm structure and prior research
indicates.source_text: 在SM4的轮计算过程中，S盒变换后的4个字节又经历了一次线性的L变换，使得这4个字节充分混淆，难以像传统模型那样利用算法中1个S盒只处理1个字节

indicates.cause_name: Welch's t-test provides a statistically sound measure of difference between two sets and allows for incremental computation, which is efficient and interpretable.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical justification from statistics and side-channel leakage assessment literature
indicates.source_text: 本文引入了Welch's t检验的方法来评估在SM4算法的选择明文功耗分析中差分后的两类功耗轨迹集合之间的差异程度，将t值作为对泄露量的衡量

indicates.cause_name: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) can reduce dimensionality while preserving the most important information, thus reducing computational complexity.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Standard dimensionality reduction technique; applied to power traces in the experiment.
indicates.source_text: 本文引入主成分分析来对原始的功耗轨迹信息进行预处理操作，使得提取出的新轨迹样本拥有更少的样本点，得到更能反映数据相关的旁路泄露信息

indicates.cause_name: Selection function 2 (based on the two least significant bits of the intermediate value C0) provides a finer classification of traces, better utilizing the leakage information.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Experimental comparison: Function 2 succeeded with 500 traces, while Functions 1 and 3 required ~800 traces.
indicates.source_text: 函数2能够获得更好的攻击效果...使用500条曲线就可以攻击成功，这种选择函数的攻击效果优于前两种的原因，在于它更加细化了对轨迹的分类

indicates.cause_name: Single-bit DPA may lead to false results and the choice of the bit has direct impact on attack success.
indicates.source_text: Because DPA builds its hypothesis on a single bit value, its assumptions regarding the leakage are very general. This may be one of the reasons for false results, so-called 'ghost peaks'. ... This fact is a motivation for multi-bit DPA

indicates.cause_name: CPA assumes linear relationship, but the relationship may be monotonic.
indicates.source_text: The CPA attack assumes a linear relationship between the predicted leakage and the physical observation. However, this requirement can be relaxed to monotonicity by using the Spearman coefficient instead of the Pearson coefficient.

indicates.cause_name: If the leakage function is injective, different key guesses yield a permutation of the partitions, making the mutual information constant.
indicates.source_text: The leakage function must be selected so that a different ˆ k must not yield a permutation of ˆ L ˆ k . ... This problem does not only pertain to MIA, but to every partitioning attack.

indicates.cause_name: Univariate attacks require synchronization, but traces may be desynchronized due to jitter or countermeasures.
indicates.source_text: Translation-invariance property of convolutional networks can be exploited to attack desynchronized traces, whereas previously described attacks would require synchronization of the traces during preprocessing.

indicates.cause_name: Hiding in time countermeasures spread the leakage over time.
indicates.source_text: When the leakage is spread in time in a more chaotic manner, e.g., by clock jitter, a sliding window attack may be used, where a finite number of (consecutive or not) time samples is summed/integrated to a single value.

indicates.cause_name: Noise amplification in higher-order attacks.
indicates.source_text: Assuming very noisy observations, the centered product combining function leads to a more efficient attack than the absolute difference combining.

indicates.cause_name: Need a threshold to reject null hypothesis with high confidence.
indicates.source_text: In side-channel analysis, the threshold ± 4.5 or ± 5 for the t-value is often considered, which roughly corresponds to significance level a ≤ 10 -5 .

indicates.cause_name: Zero columns increase degrees of freedom without contributing to the test.
indicates.source_text: Columns containing only zeros should be eliminated to decrease number of degrees of freedom.

indicates.cause_name: uncorrelated noise from voltage source, quantization, or intrinsic noise
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimentally, by observing that averaging increases correlation
indicates.source_text: uncorrelated noise ... can be decreased by averaging power traces of equal encryptions ... we found out that averaging of N=10 power traces was clearly sufficient

indicates.cause_name: external voltage source noise or low sampling rate
indicates.source_text: Averaging may not even be necessary at all if additional measurement circuitry is used in order to decouple the external voltage source from the target hardware or data is acquired at higher sampling rates.

indicates.cause_name: indicates that the same data was processed (collision)
indicates.diagnostic_check: experimentally, by observing that collisions yield high correlation
indicates.source_text: we discovered that a correlation coefficient greater than 95% generally indicated a collision.

indicates.cause_name: Profiled DPA builds templates (e.g., Gaussian, regression-based) that directly model the conditional probability distribution of leakages given the key and plaintext, capturing the true leakage function.
indicates.source_text: Separation: only profiled DPA is guaranteed to succeed against any leaking device (!)

indicates.cause_name: Gaussian templates exploit a better (profiled) model of the leakage distribution, whereas CPA relies on a simplified model (e.g., Hamming weight).
indicates.source_text: Gaussian templates outperforms CPA because it (usually) exploits a better (profiled) model

indicates.cause_name: Algorithmic noise from non-targeted parallel bits reduces the correlation between the predicted model (for the target bits) and the total leakage.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Theoretical estimation using lemmas on correlation in the presence of additive noise and the correlation between sums of variables.
indicates.source_text: Target more than 8 bits at once. Cancels (a part of) the « algorithmic noise »

indicates.cause_name: Static alignment cannot handle non-linear misalignment from countermeasures like random delays or clock randomization
indicates.source_text: 当密码模块中主动引入了随机延时或者时钟频率变化时，静态对齐技术无法获得完全对齐的信号，则应使用“动态对齐”技术。

indicates.cause_name: Implementation actively introduces random timing delays or clock frequency variations as a countermeasure, breaking the assumption of fixed operation timing.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Check if static alignment fails despite trigger synchronization
indicates.source_text: When the implementation actively introduces random timing delays or clock frequency variations, the static displacement cannot attain the full alignment of the traces. In this case, the so called dynamic alignment is applied.

indicates.cause_name: Noise in side-channel measurements can obscure leakage, requiring preprocessing to improve SNR for reliable statistical testing.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Measure SNR before and after preprocessing
indicates.source_text: A noise reduction shall be performed by the tester calculating the mean of different traces (10 cryptographic executions should be performed for the same inputs set, to get one single trace). For security level 4: filter in frequency (band-pass filter according to the module operation frequency).

indicates.cause_name: Electronic noise from power supply, clock generator, conducted/radiated emissions, and quantisation can obscure the side-channel signal.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Inspect measurement setup for noise sources
indicates.source_text: The power supply should never be powered directly by a PC. The measurement setup should be built with two PCBs: a measurement board and an interface board, isolated by opto- or magnetic couplers. The PCB with the attacked device can be put in a Faraday cage. EM should be preferred for side-channel resistance validation to reduce switching noise.

indicates.cause_name: Random inputs may not efficiently exercise the specific leakage of interest, requiring many traces to achieve statistical significance.
indicates.diagnostic_check: Compare leakage detection efficiency between random and chosen inputs
indicates.source_text: If the tester knows the value of the CSP, the tester can select a set of 'good' texts for leakage analysis with respect to the known CSP. This method can dramatically reduce the necessary number of power/EM traces.
